resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (or other open-source DFT code, e.g., GPAW, ABINIT; VASP if licensed)

access.notes: Open-source plane-wave/pseudopotential DFT package. The agent may use any DFT code capable of GGA-PBE, van der Waals correction, implicit solvent, and frequency calculations.
Optional for building and manipulating atomic structures.
Standard Python interpreter for post-processing DFT energies into Gibbs free energy changes.
